title: Chapter 770
text:
"Hmm?"

Another punch landed on Han Xiao's chest. Heber felt that something was wrong, so he turned around and stared coldly at the rapidly approaching Sisko.

"You want to snatch the Evolution Cube?" Heber's eyes were unfriendly.

Sisko had made his goal clear by publicizing the information about the Evolution Cube. Although Heber was also interested, he did not have the means to locate the Evolution Cube.

He had refused to work together because he did not want others to interrupt his one-on-one battle with Black Star and ruin his plan to establish his dominance. Seeing that the Arcane Church had suddenly taken action to restrain Ames, Sisko wanted to take advantage of the situation and blatantly make use of him, which angered Heber.

His cold eyes met Sisko's, full of warning.

Sisko was expressionless as he charged forward. He did not hesitate to take the risk of offending the Tyrant and was determined to obtain the Evolution Cube.

In his senses, the Evolution Cube was currently on Han Xiao, and his psychic power had already attacked Han Xiao. As long as he got the Evolution Cube back, he would immediately retreat and not waste his energy on attacking Han Xiao.

Seeing that the other party had ignored his warning, the hostility in Heber's eyes intensified. However, he could not abandon Black Star and turn around to attack Sisko.

Sisko had imitated his challenge and openly stood on the opposite side of Black Star, indirectly standing on the same side as him. If he gave up a good opportunity to severely injure Black Star and went to stop his nominal 'ally', then the situation would be out of control. It could be said that Sisko had already tied him up with his position.

Under the constraints of many factors, Heber could only watch as Sisko got closer and closer, unable to stop him.

"Wait until I'm done with Black Star. I'll settle this later!" Heber's expression was gloomy as he secretly made up his mind.

At this critical moment, he suddenly froze. His storm-like fists were suddenly blocked!

Hurriedly retracting his gaze from Sisko, Heber was shocked to find that Han Xiao, who should have been unable to move after being hit by his control skill, suddenly regained his mobility. His hands formed into claws and blocked each of his fists.

Heber's expression changed, and he immediately reacted. His muscles bulged, and a huge amount of power surged into his arms. Just as he was about to forcibly break Han Xiao's block and use a new control skill on Han Xiao, he suddenly froze.

From Han Xiao's arm, there was actually a terrifying strength that was no less than his own!

What was going on?!

Heber looked at Han Xiao's face in shock. He saw that a small portion of Han Xiao's mecha helmet had shattered, revealing half of Han Xiao's face. His eyes were calm.

"The damage output is really scary. It almost took half of my HP …" Han Xiao licked the blood at the corner of his mouth and grinned. "What a pity. Our battle had already lasted more than twenty minutes! "

The Mech Legion had stalled the Tyrant for long enough, and the mission reward, the Tyrant Character Summon Card, was already in his hands!

[Character Summon Card: "Tyrant" Heber], Usage: 1/3. Effect: Temporarily increase Strength by 4,000 points. Duration: 40 minutes!

He had relied on his increased Strength attribute to avoid the control skill that Heber was so determined to use!

The next moment, Han Xiao suddenly tightened his fists and grabbed Heber's fists. A terrifying amount of power filled his body. With a twist of his waist, he swung Heber up and threw him toward Sisko, who was not far away.

"What?!" In his vision, Han Xiao's figure was rapidly moving away. Heber's eyes flashed with disbelief.

In a competition of Strength, he actually lost to a Mechanic?!

What a joke!

This scene made Sisko's expression change.

Black Star had clearly fallen into Heber's control. He did not expect him to be able to break free so quickly, and in close combat at that!

This should be the strength of a Beyond Grade A Pugilist!

Not far away, the Mech Legion recovered their Mechanical Force bonuses and fired at Heber and Sisko. Sisko could only stop far away and release a psychic shield to block the bombardment. At the same time, he used his psychic power to grab Heber, who was flying backward, to help him stabilize his body.

The fierce bombardment exploded on the psychic shield, and the expanding light blocked their vision.

Before the two of them could make their next move, a sense of pressure suddenly appeared in their hearts. Turning around, they saw a huge black armed satellite passing through the bombardment outside the psychic shield and smashing toward them.

Heber did not have time to think about anything else. He crazily absorbed the dark energy, and his body expanded to the size of a giant. His fists met the armed satellite head-on, and flames shot out from behind him, wanting to block the satellite's impact.

However, the difference in size was too big. Together with Heber and Sisko, who was behind him, they were all slammed into the surface of the satellite.

Ames's eyes glowed with a dark green light. Her force field pushed the armed satellite forward like a marble, drawing an arc in the air and smashing toward the Arcane Church's fleet.

Because of the Arcane Church's fleet, she was unable to stop Sisko immediately. Ames was quite annoyed. Luckily, Black Star had resolved the danger with his own strength. She did not hesitate and immediately supported him, treating the Arcane Church's fleet as a target of attack.

Facing the huge armed satellite, the Arcane Church's fleet decisively opened fire. Dark Energy Annihilation Cannons rained down on the armed satellite like a storm, blowing it up.

This was the largest explosion since the start of the battle. The expanding light stung the eyes of countless spectators, and they could not help but close their eyes. Only the intermediate and high-grade Supers could barely open their eyes.

The aftermath of the explosion dissipated, and everyone finally saw the current situation clearly.

Han Xiao and Ames were in the center of the battlefield, standing together. Heber and Sisko took on the explosion and hovered in front of the Arcane Church's fleet. The four Beyond Grade As from both sides faced each other.

The situation changed too quickly, and no one could react in time. Now that they regained their senses, their eyes all focused on Han Xiao. Their eyes were filled with shock.

The situation just now was so dangerous that they could not help but worry for Han Xiao. They could still clearly remember that Han Xiao had used his strength to counter Heber. He had used the most direct and forceful method to break the pincer attack of Heber and Sisko!

"Hu … hu …" Sylvia took a deep breath. She was really shocked just now.

Hella loosened her fists, and her tense body relaxed.

The spectators calmed down and were attracted by the situation in front of them.

"Sisko and Ames have both made their moves. I'm afraid it won't be a one-on-one battle but a chaotic one."

"The Arcane Church has also intervened. Not only the Beyond Grade As, the fleets of both sides will probably start fighting!"

"The Red Empire will definitely react. There might even be a war."

"I think we should retreat a little more …"

Countless people were nervous. It was originally a battle between Beyond Grade As, but the intervention of the Arcane Church had changed the situation.

In terms of strength, Heber's side, which had the Red Empire and the Arcane Church's support, completely crushed Black Star's side. If the fleets also started a chaotic battle, Black Star's side would definitely be at an absolute disadvantage.

Sisko's expression was not good, and he was unwilling. His sneak attack had failed, and his plan to take advantage of the situation had failed. He had also made his move, and he could no longer watch from the side. Now, he could only snatch the Evolution Cube head-on, which would be much more difficult.

He turned to look at Heber, only to see that Heber was also looking at him with a sharp gaze.

Sisko knew that his previous actions had offended the Tyrant, and the two of them were now at odds. He sighed inwardly and sent a message to Heber via telepathy.

"Ames has already intervened. You can't continue fighting Black Star alone. They'll fight you two against one, and you need help … We'll talk about what happened just now later. Let's work together first. I have the Arcane Church, and you have the Red Empire. We'll send out our fleets to start a war. If you help me get the Evolution Cube back, the Arcane Church and I can give you enough benefits. "

Heber frowned. His plan had been disrupted, and he really wanted to strangle Sisko. When Sisko had requested to work together, he had made a similar suggestion. Heber had rejected it then, and he did not want to agree to it now either.

The Red Empire was not invited by him; they had made some kind of deal with Klent. Heber was not very clear about the details. However, since the Red Empire had come, their attitude was to support him. He did not want this arranged battle to turn into a full-scale war. This was far from his original intention.

However, at this time, the Red Empire's fleet suddenly moved, attracting everyone's attention.

The Red Empire's fleet turned around, and countless cannons were aimed at the Arcane Church's fleet. Before anyone could react, the Red Empire's fleet suddenly opened fire!

Countless particle cannons bombarded the Arcane Church's fleet. The Arcane Church's fleet was caught off guard by the sudden attack from the side.

At this moment, no matter which side they belonged to, everyone was dumbfounded!

What — what's going on?

Upon seeing this, Han Xiao's eyes sparkled.

"Zoel has made his move!"

—

(I've not been in a good state recently. I feel like I'm suffering from orgasm impotence.)
